_catatan: Kontrak kueri GFW Data API untuk statistik karbon per poligon (docs/karbon/RANCANGAN.md §2-3). SATU sumber untuk scripts/karbon/statistik.py dan src/karbon.js. POST https://data-api.globalforestwatch.org/dataset/<dataset>/<versi>/query/json, body {sql, geometry}, header huruf kecil persis 'x-api-key'. Versi 'harian' = vYYYYMMDD tanggal UTC hari ini, mundur sampai 3 hari bila 404.

luas.sql: SELECT SUM(area__ha) AS ha FROM results

tutupan.sql: SELECT umd_tree_cover_density_2000__threshold AS ambang, is__umd_regional_primary_forest_2001 AS primer, SUM(area__ha) AS ha, SUM(gfw_aboveground_carbon_stock_2000__Mg_C) AS atas, SUM(gfw_belowground_carbon_stock_2000__Mg_C) AS bawah, SUM(gfw_soil_carbon_stock_2000__Mg_C) AS tanah FROM results GROUP BY umd_tree_cover_density_2000__threshold, is__umd_regional_primary_forest_2001

tutupan_gambut.sql: SELECT umd_tree_cover_density_2000__threshold AS ambang, SUM(area__ha) AS ha FROM results WHERE is__gfw_peatlands = 1 GROUP BY umd_tree_cover_density_2000__threshold

hilang.sql: SELECT umd_tree_cover_loss__year AS th, is__umd_regional_primary_forest_2001 AS primer, SUM(area__ha) AS ha, SUM(gfw_forest_carbon_gross_emissions__Mg_CO2e) AS co2 FROM results WHERE umd_tree_cover_density_2000__threshold >= 30 AND umd_tree_cover_loss__year >= 2001 GROUP BY umd_tree_cover_loss__year, is__umd_regional_primary_forest_2001

hilang_gambut.sql: SELECT umd_tree_cover_loss__year AS th, SUM(area__ha) AS ha FROM results WHERE is__gfw_peatlands = 1 AND umd_tree_cover_density_2000__threshold >= 30 AND umd_tree_cover_loss__year >= 2001 GROUP BY umd_tree_cover_loss__year

hilang_pendorong.sql: SELECT umd_tree_cover_loss__year AS th, wri_google_tree_cover_loss_drivers__category AS pendorong, SUM(area__ha) AS ha, SUM(gfw_forest_carbon_gross_emissions__Mg_CO2e) AS co2 FROM results WHERE umd_tree_cover_density_2000__threshold >= 30 AND umd_tree_cover_loss__year >= 2001 GROUP BY umd_tree_cover_loss__year, wri_google_tree_cover_loss_drivers__category
hilang_pendorong._catatan: Kueri sendiri karena GROUP BY pada lapisan pendorong membuang piksel tanpa pendorong (lihat _null_group). Selisih total hilang dikurangi jumlah per pendorong = 'tanpa_pendorong'.

hilang_api.sql: SELECT umd_tree_cover_loss_from_fires__year AS th, SUM(area__ha) AS ha FROM results WHERE umd_tree_cover_density_2000__threshold >= 30 AND umd_tree_cover_loss_from_fires__year >= 2001 GROUP BY umd_tree_cover_loss_from_fires__year

tutupan2017.sql: SELECT idn_land_cover_2017__class AS tutupan, SUM(area__ha) AS ha FROM results GROUP BY idn_land_cover_2017__class

kawasan.sql: SELECT idn_forest_area__class AS kawasan, SUM(area__ha) AS ha FROM results GROUP BY idn_forest_area__class

pendorong.sql: SELECT wri_google_tree_cover_loss_drivers__category AS kategori, SUM(area__ha) AS ha FROM results WHERE umd_tree_cover_density_2000__threshold >= 30 AND umd_tree_cover_loss__year >= 2001 GROUP BY wri_google_tree_cover_loss_drivers__category

serapan.sql: SELECT SUM(gfw_forest_carbon_gross_removals__Mg_CO2e) AS serapan FROM results WHERE umd_tree_cover_density_2000__threshold >= 30

peringatan.sql: SELECT latitude AS lat, longitude AS lon, gfw_integrated_alerts__date AS tanggal, gfw_integrated_alerts__confidence AS keyakinan FROM results WHERE gfw_integrated_alerts__date >= '{sejak}'

_null_group: GROUP BY membuang piksel yang lapisannya kosong (raster GFW). is__gfw_peatlands kosong di luar gambut: dikelompokkan bersama ambang, poligon Pangean tinggal 1.173 dari 50.255 ha (22 Okt 2026). Maka gambut = filter WHERE terpisah, tutupan dan kawasan = kueri terpisah, luas = SUM tanpa GROUP BY (piksel tutupan <10% tidak punya ambang). Ambang adalah BIN: baris 30+50+75 = WHERE ambang >= 30 (Pangean 50.195,53 ha keduanya).
_peringatan: Kueri peringatan mengembalikan DAFTAR PIKSEL (SUM/GROUP BY dengan latitude ditolak GFW, 22 Okt 2026). Klien mengelompokkan piksel per (tanggal, sel 0,005 derajat) jadi satu kejadian; luas_ha = n x (0,0001 x 111320 m)^2 x cos(lat) / 10000.
_pendorong: Urutan kelas Sims dkk. 2025 (WRI/Google, metadata GFW): 1 pertanian permanen, 2 komoditas keras, 3 perladangan berpindah, 4 tebang/kehutanan, 5 kebakaran liar, 6 permukiman & infrastruktur, 7 gangguan alami lain. Pendorong = dominan per sel 1 km untuk 2001-2025, bukan per tahun.
